diff --git a/fetcher/client.py b/fetcher/client.py
index 85c871e..500de1c 100644
--- a/fetcher/client.py
+++ b/fetcher/client.py
@@ -15,4 +15,11 @@ def fetch(send, url: str, *, sleep=time.sleep) -> str:
     A transient response is retried per the documented backoff schedule; ``sleep``
     is injectable so tests can observe the schedule without waiting.
     """
-    return send(url)
+    response = send(url)
+    if RETRY_MARKER in response:
+        for delay in DELAYS_S:
+            sleep(delay)
+            response = send(url)
+        if RETRY_MARKER in response:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"Backend transient hiccup persisted: {RETRY_MARKER}")
+    return response
